messages:
nina: quick heads-up from my docs pass 12; audit-exports examples show mixed retention fields and one example contains raw prompt text. SOC2 reviewers will flag.

omar: ugh. what names are floating around? i found `expiresAt`, `ttl_seconds`, `retention_days` across samples.

jess: suggestion: pick `retention_period_days` (int) for SDK examples and migration notes that map old names -> new. keeps it simple for customers.

security: +1. also do NOT show raw prompt payloads in public docs. replace with `prompt_id: "p_abc123"` and a short note about audited admin lookups.

compliance: wording guidance: use "retained for N days" and never words like "permanent" or "forever". add a short parenthetical: "may be retained longer for legal hold or investigations".

nina: can we also clarify the export example that currently implies instant tenant-wide exports? that requires an approval flow. either remove or explicitly mark: "admin approval required".

omar: i'll open a small PR to: 1) change examples across JS/Py/Go/Ruby to `retention_period_days`, 2) replace raw prompt with pseudonymized `prompt_id` example, 3) add migration mapping table, 4) add export approval callout in the example.

docbot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4512 by omar - "docs: unify retention snippet naming; pseudonymize prompt example; clarify export approval"

jess: nice. can you also add a quick docs-lint check that greps for `prompt_text` or `prompt:` in examples so this doesn't regress? even a tiny CI grep is helpful.

omar: good idea. i'll add a basic check and a unit that validates example fields against the canonical audit schema.

security: when you open the PR, tag @compliance and @security for wording & risk review. i'll do a quick pass once it's up.

compliance: also include an internal link to the retention playbook in the PR description for reviewers: (internal) https://redwood-internal.company/retention-playbook.

nina: thanks — after reviews, please squash-merge and include a CHANGELOG entry: "docs(security): harmonize retention sample fields; remove raw prompt sample; clarify export approval process."

omar: ack, will ping when PR is ready for final sign-off. small change but should prevent audit confusion.

jess: thanks all :+1:

docbot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #4512 (run: `make docs-build && make docs-lint`).
